title: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
abstract: arXiv:2611.31614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).

translated_title: Tablassert：从生物医学表格中声明式提取知识图谱
translated_abstract: 生物医学研究论文中发表的表格，尤其是补充表格，捕捉了可能因多种原因（包括统计显著性较低、篇幅限制和叙事范围）而未出现在手稿正文中的知识断言。这些表格包含的数据（例如关联统计、实验检测读数、人工整理的基因列表和组学数据）编码了生物实体之间的关系。Tablassert 可将此类表格数据转换为可供 NCATS 生物医学数据翻译器使用的知识图谱。用户在 YAML 中声明每个表格的数据如何映射到主语-谓语-宾语-限定符语句；Tablassert 将自由文本（例如“肺癌”）解析为标准标识符，附加来源信息和统计数据，并输出符合 Translator 标准的图文件。
tldr: Tablassert 是一个基于 YAML 声明式配置的工具，可将生物医学论文中的表格数据自动转换为符合 NCATS 生物医学数据翻译器标准的知识图谱，并能将自由文本解析为标准标识符。
en_tdlr: Tablassert is a declarative YAML-based tool that converts biomedical tabular data into standardized knowledge graphs for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator, resolving free text to standard identifiers while attaching provenance and statistics.
